preconditions.description: The number of test cases is between 1 and 5, inclusive.
The number of queries in each test case is between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.
Each query contains a positive integer X between 1 and 10^5, inclusive.

postconditions.description: The size of the set S is the sum of the number of elements with an even number of 1-s and the number of elements with an odd number of 1-s.

postconditions.expression: all(count_ones(y) % 2 == 0 for y in S if y != X)
postconditions.description: All elements inserted into S, except for X, have an even number of 1-s in their binary representation.

postconditions.expression: all(count_ones(y ^ X) % 2 == 1 for y in S if y != X)
postconditions.description: All elements inserted into S, except for X, when XORed with X, have an odd number of 1-s in their binary representation.

postconditions.expression: E == sum(1 for y in S if count_ones(y) % 2 == 0)
postconditions.description: The number of elements with an even number of 1-s is the count of elements in S whose binary representation has an even number of 1-s.

postconditions.expression: O == sum(1 for y in S if count_ones(y) % 2 == 1)
postconditions.description: The number of elements with an odd number of 1-s is the count of elements in S whose binary representation has an odd number of 1-s.
